name: easydpi
description: The default template for a Neutralinojs app. It's possible to use your favorite frontend framework by using [these steps](https://neutralino.js.org/docs/getting-started/using-frontend-libraries).

scripts.tag: powershell -Command "$ver = (Get-Content package.json | ConvertFrom-Json).version; git tag v$ver; git push origin v$ver"
scripts.manual-release-2: npm run git push --follow-tags origin master
